spans.s: --the wife of Nakta and mother of Gaya. भा. V. १५. 6.

--a Gandharva and a son of ऋषभ and a sage who was a भागवत; in the guise of Ugrasena became the father of Kamsa;
1: भा.

. २१; X. ३६. २४ [१०-26].
discoursed to Nimi on the अवतार्स् of Hari with different purposes.
2: Ib.

--a son of ययाति and सर्मिष्ठा and father of Babhru and Satu;
1: भा. IX. १८, ३३ and ४१; २३. १४; Br.

. १३३; वा. 1. १५६; ९३. १७; ९९. 7; Vi. IV. १७. 1.
after being refused by Yadu and Turvasu approached by ययाति; he also declined to part with his youth to his father and was therefore cursed to have no pleasures in life and to be wandering about the countries and oceans with no settled kingdom;
2: M. २४. ५४; ३२. १०; २३. १६-20; वा. ४५. ५०; Vi. IV. १०. 6, १३.
became over-lord of the south-eastern (west ब्र्। प्।, वा। प्। and वि। प्।) part of the kingdom;
3: M. ३४. ३०; वा. ४५. ९०; Vi. १०. ३१.
from him begins the Bhoja line.
4: M. ४८. 6.
